title: Sectionwise short exactness gives a short exact sequence of etale Cech complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let S be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let U be an object, T any indexing type, and f_t : V_t -> U any family, not necessarily a covering. Suppose S.g is surjective on sections over every nonempty iterated fibre product V_(a_0) x_U ... x_U V_(a_p), for all p >= 0 and all tuples a : Fin(p+1) -> T. Then applying the Cech complex functor [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex] to S gives a short exact sequence of cochain complexes of abelian groups. No injectivity or Cech-acyclicity assumption is needed.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9 (lemma-cech-vanish-collection), proof: short exact sequence of Cech complexes after sectionwise exactness

proof.text: The sheaf-to-presheaf functor and object evaluation preserve finite limits, so a short exact sheaf sequence evaluates to an exact sequence on the left at each intersection. Surjectivity is assumed, so each section sequence is short exact.

In degree p the Cech maps are products of section maps over all tuples. Products of short exact sequences of abelian groups are short exact, by choosing preimages componentwise; injectivity and exactness at the middle are likewise componentwise. Empty index products are zero and give a short exact zero sequence. Identify the categorical product via its universal property.
A sequence of cochain complexes is short exact if and only if it is degreewise short exact. Apply this criterion.

mathlib_searches.query: A short exact sequence of sheaves surjective on sections at all intersections induces a short exact sequence of Cech complexes
mathlib_searches.results: MayerVietorisSquare.shortComplex_shortExact concerns a different sheaf sequence; no match for this statement.
ShortExact.map requires preservation of left and right homology; the Cech functor is not exact on arbitrary sheaf sequences. The sectionwise hypothesis needs separate glue.
HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact and AddCommGrpCat.HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete J) supply ingredients, but no direct Cech result.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_cech_shortExact_of_sections
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (U : X.Etale) (T : Type (u + 1))
    (V : T → X.Etale) (f : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U)
    (hsurj : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → T),
      Function.Surjective (S.g.hom.app
        (op (piObj (fun j : Fin (p + 1) ↦ Over.mk (f (a j)))).left))) :
    (S.map (sheafToPresheaf _ _ ⋙
      (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj (Over.forget U).op ⋙
      cechComplexFunctor (fun t ↦ Over.mk (f t)))).ShortExact
